description: §66.3 rules 5 and 7: the logical operators `!` and `&&` are not members of the closed inferable set, so `<closed=(!@open)/>` and `<both=(@open && @ready)/>` are each E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE.
rationale: §66.3 rule 5: the set "is closed: it grows only by a ruling" and names "the logical operators `!` / `&&` / `||` and `is given` / `is not`" outside it; rule 7: outside the set is E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 ruling 3: the set is enumerated normatively).
